messages.subject: Revolution Analytics
parts:
I am a statistician starting to work with "Big Data". Can anyone direct me to a place
where I can find information on the various algorithms (and methods) used in this  area.

I find a lot of information on storing and retrieving data but little informaiton on how to analysise these data

Collecting streams of big data is one thing; doing something useful with all that data is another. But the former without the latter won't win business intelligence, analytics and IT teams any plaudits from corporate executives.

Hi Reidar,

This form is for Revolution R Open, which has many uses for data science generally but isn't specifically targeted at "Big Data" applications specifically. For that, you may want to look at Revolution R Enterprise or at blog posts I have written on the topic in the Revolutions blog Big Data section: http://blog.revolutionanalytics.com/big-data/

Kind regards,
